subject: Mediconnect security intake — SOC 2 Type II request & trust portal access
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@mediconnect.com>, Luke Harper <procurement@mediconnect.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mediconnect security intake — SOC 2 Type II request & trust portal access

Hi Claire / Luke,

Great to meet you both on the call earlier — quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Ask: Mediconnect requested Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter covering the period through your procurement review.
- Compliance notes you raised: GDPR data residency questions and HIPAA applicability for PHI flows (you said some integrations will carry patient identifiers).
- You wanted vendor security questionnaire kickoff (DDQ) and temporary access to our Trust Portal for report/attestation artifacts.

Action items we committed to:
1) Share our SOC 2 Type II report and an interim bridge letter.
2) Provision Trust Portal access (or SFTP fallback) and confirm SSO options.
3) Send a vendor DDQ template for your team to complete.

I've attached the call notes and the demo snippets for context (sales-demo-notes.pdf).

I'll loop in Aditya from security for the artifacts and Neha from compliance to confirm HIPAA/GDPR posture. Expect the SOC2/bridge letter and DDQ template within 48 hours.

Thanks — Tessa
--
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: sales-demo-notes.pdf

From: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@mediconnect.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Luke Harper <procurement@mediconnect.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mediconnect security intake — SOC 2 Type II request & trust portal access

Thanks, Tessa — helpful recap. A couple of clarifications from my side: 

- Procurement will need the full SOC 2 Type II PDF and a bridge letter that explicitly states the report coverage dates and whether the report includes the serving/runtime and data handling controls.
- For HIPAA: we will scope only the connectors that touch PHI, but we need confirmation of any Business Associate Agreement (we can start an internal request once we see the report).
- Trust Portal: we prefer SSO (SAML) if you support it; otherwise portal invite or temporary SFTP works.

Please also include a short summary of how you isolate customer data between hosted and dedicated environments — our security team will ask about segmentation.

Luke, can you confirm the procurement timeline? We may loop legal depending on the BAA ask.

-Claire
Security Lead, Mediconnect

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@mediconnect.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mediconnect security intake — SOC 2 Type II request & trust portal access

Hi Claire — thanks for the details. Quick technical answers and what we'll send now: 

1) SOC 2 artifacts: We can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31) plus an interim bridge letter that confirms no material control changes since the report period and calls out the serving/runtime and data handling controls relevant to inference.

2) Trust Portal & access: We support SAML SSO for enterprise customers. If you can share a SAML metadata file or IdP entity ID, we can provision SSO access; otherwise we'll invite emails directly into the Trust Portal. Temporary SFTP drop is available as a fallback. Portal invites usually land within 24–48 hours after we get account list/IdP metadata.

3) Segmentation summary: Hosted API tenants are logically isolated with tenant scoping + encryption-at-rest; Dedicated pools provide physical separation on reserved GPU clusters and customer-managed VPC options for Private deployments. I'll attach a short 1‑page isolation summary if that helps.

I've attached the vendor DDQ template (vendor-ddq.xlsx) and a brief SOC2 request checklist (soc2-typeii-request.docx) to speed things up.

Next steps:
- Claire: share list of emails for portal invites or SAML metadata.
- Luke: procurement preference (PO/DocuSign timeline) and any specific billing requirements.

We aim to have the report and bridge letter ready for portal upload within 48 hours once I confirm the access path.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
attachments: vendor-ddq.xlsx; soc2-typeii-request.docx

Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mediconnect security intake — SOC 2 Type II request & trust portal access

Aditya — thanks for the speedy reply and attachments. Luke confirmed procurement can review the SOC2/bridge letter as long as we have portal access.

We will:
- Send SAML metadata by end of day today (IdP: Okta).
- Share the list of users for portal invites (security + procurement + legal).

Procurement note: If the portal setup takes longer than 48 hours we will accept an SFTP bundle for immediate review. Once we've ingested the artifacts we'll open a BAA request if HIPAA is required.

I'll upload the vendor DDQ to the portal after I receive the template — thanks for that. Point person for portal upload / SSO troubleshooting: Tessa (for account coordination) and Aditya (for security artifacts).

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Claire
Security Lead, Mediconnect
